action: New compound layout replacing a golf-cart garage stand-in.
functionalIdentity: A30x20m event broadcast compound consisting of one period box broadcast truck, one uplink van with a roof dish, a generator box, cable reels and a small practical equipment workbench. Arrange truck left, van rear-right, generator front-right, with one open service gap at model front; fixed component layout rotates as one object. Separate physical feet/wheels and no painted ground slab. It must read as support vehicles, not a garage.

generationConstraints: Same one physical object/layout in all eight cells; doors, windows, serving openings, rear braces, stairs, wheels, dishes and equipment never teleport between sides.
Empty functional facilities; no people stamped into sprites. Transparent background, ample cell margins, equal scale within each sheet, no labels or gridlines.
No generic ground plates. Functional hitting mat, vehicle wheels, structure supports and admission hardware are part of their actual objects.
Use the separate style-authority PNG for painterly material/color style; role references may be photoreal, ornate, mislabeled, modern or shanty and are not style authorities.
Budget means ordinary worn1950sreal-world construction; upgraded means attractive maintained period facilities. No goblin village, rope-lashed logs, gratuitous torn tarps or gold filigree.
No captions, brand names or baked score/name/yardage text; scoring and information faces remain blank for data. A simple medical symbol may identify first aid.
